children.name: Dendrophthora coronata Canelón, S.M.Niño, Dorr & Caraballo
children.description: Description. Aerial parasitic shrubs, monoecious; yellow-orange when fresh, drying blackish or dark green. Stems woody, with multiple branches, 30 - 45 cm long, terete, surface coarse with parallel striations, with a dense layer of coroniform trichomes covering the entire plant; mature nodes separated by 2 - 3.5 cm long intervals, dichotomous; cataphylls 0.5 - 1 mm long at nodes, found 1 - 2 cm above nodes as branches became older. Leaves opposite, coriaceous; petioles flattened, 0.5 - 2 mm long
